name: City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Wednesday, June 24, 2015 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Proclamation recognizing Sharon Estrada for 24 years of service to the City of Lomita.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Adjourned Regular Meeting of June 1, 2015 and Regular Meeting held on June 10, 2015
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item 7B
c.
Resolution 2015-29 Approving the Demands and Payroll.
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.
Item 7C
d.
Authorize the City Manager to execute a Professional Services Agreement with SA Associates for preparation of the 2015 Urban Water Management Plan.
ACTION: That the City Manager be authorized to execute a Professional Services Agreement (PSA) for a not to exceed amount of $21,000 with SA Associates for the preparation of the City's 2015 Urban Water Management Plan (UWMP).
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
Item 7D
8.
DISCUSSION/CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL TO SUBMIT THE DOMINGUEZ CHANNEL ENHANCED WATERSHED MANAGEMENT PLAN TO THE REGIONAL WATER QUALITY CONTROL BOARD AND ADOPTION OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY PROGRAM ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT FOR THE PROJECT AND CORRESPONDING DOCUMENTATION
Presented by Public Works Director McAvoy
Res 2015-30 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving and authorizing submittal of the Dominguez Channel Enhanced Watershed Management Program (EWMP) Plan to the Regional Water Quality Control Board and adopting the Los Angeles County Flood Control District's Program Environmental Impact Report (PEIR) for EWMPS and the Corresponding Findings, Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program, and Statement of Overriding Considerations
ACTION: Staffs recommends that the City Council:
1)
Adopt Resolution No. 2015-30; and
2)
Authorize the City Manager to submit the Dominguez Channel Enhanced Watershed Management Program (EWMP) Plan to the Los Angeles Regional Water Quality Control Board; and
3)
Adopt the Los Angeles County Flood Control District's Program Environmental Impact Report for EWMPs and the corresponding Findings, Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program, and Statement of Overriding Consideration
Item 8
9.
DISCUSSION/CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTION OF THE PROPOSED FISCAL YEAR 2015-16 BUDGET AND RELATED RESOLUTIONS
Presented by City Manager Rock and Administrative Services Director Chavez
a.
Res 2015-31 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita adopting the City Budget for the Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 2015 and ending June 30, 2016.
b.
Res 2015-32 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita adopting a Financial Investment Policy for Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 2015 and ending June 30, 2016.
c.
Res 2015-33 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita amending Resolution No. 81-56, a resolution establishing a Compensation Plan for employees for Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 2015 and ending June 30, 2016.
d.
Res 2015-34 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita establishing the part-time and temporary employment policy and compensation plan for Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 2015 and ending June 30, 2016.
e.
Res 2015-35 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita confirming the factors used for calculating the Annual Appropriation Limit for Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 2015 and ending June 30, 2016.
ACTION: That said resolutions A-E, be adopted.
Item 9
10.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be on July 8, 2015, at 6:30 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
